gg.title: Where to advertise
gg.sub: District by district: where parcels are delivered and paid for, and where they come back. Advice only — nothing here changes a budget or a campaign.
gg.off: Advice is off: below are the figures only. Switch it on in its card to give each district a word and get the lists to copy.
gg.readOnly: You can see this page. Changing its card needs the permission to manage campaigns.
gg.wh_more: Advertise more here: parcels are delivered and paid.
gg.wh_less: Advertise less here: too many parcels come back.
gg.tableSub: Most settled orders first. Return rate = returned ÷ (delivered + returned).
gg.noMoney: Sales show only for those who may see the books.
gg.empty: No delivered or returned orders with a district in this time.
gg.unknown: {n} orders had no district on their address and are left out.
gg.copySub: Paste into an ad platform's location targeting yourself. Nothing is sent from here.
gg.cardText: On: each district gets a word from its return rate and number of orders, and the lists to copy appear. Advice only.
gg.how1: Every delivered and returned order counts in the district of its delivery address.
gg.how2: A district with few returns and enough orders is worth more ads; one with many returns is worth fewer.
gg.how3: Pick a category to see where that category sells.
gg.how4: Copy the lists into the ad platform yourself: the shop never changes a budget or a target by itself.
